evidence: Official MEMX documentation describes MEMOIR Top as real-time top-of-book best bid/best offer on the MEMX exchange.

providers.reopen_condition: MEMX offers a sanctioned consolidated UTP/National-NBBO product covering all required U.S. venues.

providers.reopen_condition: NYSE product becomes actual all-venue National NBBO under unconditional permanent-$0 automated/non-display entitlement.

evidence: MIAX Pearl Equities Top of Market is an exchange-native top-of-book feed, not consolidated National NBBO.

evidence: FINRA TRFs are facilities for reporting transactions executed otherwise than on an exchange.

FINRA Developer Equity datasets expose OTC trade/equity data; they do not establish the required National NBBO quote-event stream.
providers.reopen_condition: FINRA exposes a sanctioned realtime all-venue National NBBO quote+trade API with independent event timestamps and strict permanent-$0 automated entitlement.
